svg.title: Cosine schedule, weight RMS, and effective learning rate

cc:Work.dc:title: Cosine schedule, weight RMS, and effective learning rate
cc:Work.dc:description: Schematic: 10,000 steps; 1% linear warmup then cosine decay to zero; weight decay 0.1; initial weight RMS 0.02; constant orthogonal gradient RMS 1. Blue/green/red: peak lr 0.0015/0.003/0.006. Effective lr in RMS units is lr/RMS(W).
